Question 2
?

Given that f(x,y)=arcsin⁡(xy), find the set of values (x,y) on which ∂f∂y exists.

a
{(x,y):xy>1}
b
{(x,y):xy<1}
c
{(x,y):−1≤xy≤1}
d
{(x,y):xy≠1}
e
{(x,y):−1<xy<1}
